description: Defines an internal record class 'AdoNetStreamMessageAck' in the Orleans streaming ADO.NET provider, representing an acknowledgement for a message enqueued in the storage, including identifiers and a default constructor.

classes.name: AdoNetStreamMessageAck
classes.description: Represents an acknowledgement from storage that a message was enqueued, containing identifiers such as ServiceId, ProviderId, QueueId, and MessageId.

methods.name: AdoNetStreamMessageAck()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the acknowledgement with empty strings and zero MessageId.
